title: $BATL 🐂📈- Potential multibagger?
summary: BATL – Undervalued Permian Asset with Significant Re-Rating PotentialCurrently trading at $1.20 (~$18M enterprise value) while proved reserves alone have a PV-10 of $450–550M — the market is pricing the asset at just 3–4% of proven reserve value.Core holding: 52,000 net acres of Tier-1 Delaware Basin acreageClean balance sheet: fully funded, $50M cash, covenant relief through mid-2027, no dilutionPositive cash flow and self-sustaining operationsManagement has repeatedly stated in every filing that it is actively pursuing strategic alternatives, including merger, acquisition, or divestiture — the company is formally for sale.Precedent:• Dec 2023 – Fury Resources $9.80/share all-cash bid• Later revised to ~$7/share (both failed solely due to Fury’s financing issues)With Permian M&A accelerating under a pro-energy administration and recent comps north of $50–100k per flowing barrel, any successful transaction (or even a new credible bid) would likely start well above prior levels.BATL remains one of the most mispriced oil & gas assets in the public markets — 5–10x upside on a takeout at private-market or historical bid valuations. Not financial advice – conduct your own due diligence.submitted by/u/ApartmentEvery6303[link][comments]
